text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes our first lesson of<n>the new year.
I look forward to<n>spending a productive year with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Hayahideee! Let's<n>make it a
great one!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Happy New Year, Ticket. How<n>many times do
you plan to say that,<n>though? This is already your
third<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's okay! Hey, which crown<n>are you
gunning for this year?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown? The Triple<n>Tiara? I
chose—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Let me guess. You chose the Classic<n>Triple Crown
tour because it has the<n>Japanese Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No way! How'd you know?! That'sexactly right! Running in the Derby'smy dream!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is SO awesome!<n>I remember
how wild the crowd went<n>when I watched it with
my mom as a<n>kid!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Young Ticket
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Does your tummy<n>hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Sniff. It's not that. I'm just—hic!—sohappy she won!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
My dream has always been to see<n>her win the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob... The Derby is filled withso many dreams...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I swear, she must've told that story a<n>million times
already.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, well, that's how important it is<n>to her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I swear—one day, I'll be the Derby<n>Champiooon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You should wipe your nose,<n>Ticket. Do you
have any tissues on<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, what tour did you choose,<n>Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh. Then all three of us chose the<n>same one...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I just tripped.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You didn't skip<n>breakfast again, did
you? If you're<n>not feeling well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I said I'm fine. And I had breakfast,<n>okay? I really
wish you'd stop<n>already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I know—you saw me trip and got<n>worried. I get it, but
I just... I don't<n>wanna hear it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you're cut out for<n>racing? Maybe you
should<n>reconsider. I don't think you have the
constitution for it...

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Colega de Classe A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're seriously planning to go<n>to Tracen
Academy? You can't be for<n>real. I doubt they'd let
a runt like you<n>enter the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Colega de Classe B
text_block_list.text:
Keep dreaming, shorty. Not like<n>anything you try will
turn out good<n>anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win. Even if I have to go<n>up against
both of you, I'm going to<n>win the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, there's no point. I have to<n>win and make
my haters eat their<n>words.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand, Taishin. I wouldn't<n>expect anything
less from you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I don't intend to lose either. No<n>matter if I race
against you or Ticket, I<n>won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Good. It'll be more satisfying when I<n>beat you, then.
See you at the Satsuki<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, this is our first<n>meeting this
year, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year to you too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, getting down to business... My<n>goals haven't
changed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I still plan on becoming a racer whom<n>no one can
beat. I'm going to become<n>the greatest
Umamusume of all time.
choice_data_list:
I assume winning against Brian is also one of your
goals?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's right—which is why I want to<n>finalize my
winning equation as<n>quickly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What do you think is lacking from my<n>equation at
the moment?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started with our<n>meeting. That's why
we're here in<n>the first place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We can test things out in practice<n>afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I share a spirited discussion with<n>Biwa Hayahide
about racing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good point. Food is not only<n>essential for
maintaining health, it's<n>also important for
moderating stress.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should have a banana<n>parfait once in a
while...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I mean, I like other things<n>too. Like
banana cake...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Anyway, stop distracting me from our<n>real topic!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having finished our first meeting of<n>the year, Biwa
Hayahide and I treat<n>ourselves to a banana parfait.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Technique? Interesting...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's start by gathering the data we<n>need.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We'll look at the Classic winners<n>from the past ten
years and see if we<n>can identify any trends.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're absolutely right. That's notenough, is it? Let's go throughtwenty years' worth of data.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wish I'd kept my mouth shut, but<n>still, it's a
productive use of time.
